items.text: Yehova anayankhula ndi Mika wa ku Moreseti pa nthawi ya ulamuliro wa Yotamu, Ahazi ndi Hezekiya, mafumu a ku Yuda. Awa ndi masomphenya amene iye anaona onena za Samariya ndi Yerusalemu.
Tamverani, inu anthu a mitundu yonse,
mvetsera iwe dziko lapansi ndi okhala mʼmenemo,
pakuti Ambuye Yehova achitira umboni wokutsutsani,
Ambuye akuyankhula ali mʼnyumba yake yopatulika.
Taonani! Yehova akubwera kuchokera ku malo ake;
Iye akutsika ndipo akuponda pa malo okwera a dziko lapansi.
Zonsezi ndi chifukwa cha cholakwa cha Yakobo,
chifukwa cha machimo a nyumba ya Israeli.
Kodi malo achipembedzo a Yuda ndi ati?
mphatso zake zonse ndidzazitentha ndi moto;
ndidzawononga zifanizo zonse za milungu yake.
Popeza analandira mphatso zake kuchokera ku malipiro a akazi achiwerewere,
mphatsozonso zidzagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi ena ngati malipiro a akazi achiwerewere."
Chifukwa cha zimenezi ine ndidzalira momvetsa chisoni;
Chafika pa chipata chenicheni cha anthu anga,
muzipita ku ukapolo muli amaliseche ndi amanyazi.
Anthu amene amakhala ku Maroti akubuwula ndi ululu,
lafika mpaka pa chipata cha Yerusalemu.
Metani mipala mitu yanu kuonetsa kuti mukulirira
pakuti anawo adzatengedwa pakati panu kupita ku ukapolo.

items.text: Zokonzekera za Munthu ndi Zokonzekera za Mulungu
kwa amene amakonzekera kuchita zoyipa usiku pa mabedi awo!
chifukwa ali ndi mphamvu zochitira zimenezo.
"Ine ndikukonzekera kubweretsa tsoka pa anthu awa,
Wapereka minda yathu kwa anthu otiwukira.' "
Nʼchifukwa chake simudzakhala ndi munthu mu msonkhano wa Yehova
Inu nyumba ya Yakobo, monga zimenezi ndi zoyenera kuzinena:
monga anthu amene akubwera ku nkhondo.
Pakuti ano si malo anu opumulirapo,
Ngati munthu wabodza ndi wachinyengo abwera nʼkunena kuti,
'Ine ndidzanenera ndipo mudzakhala ndi vinyo ndi mowa wambiri,
woteroyo adzakhala mneneri amene anthu awa angamukonde!'
ndidzawasonkhanitsa pamodzi otsala a ku Israeli.
malowo adzadzaza ndi chinamtindi cha anthu.

items.text: Kodi sindinu oyenera kudziwa kuweruza molungama,
inu amene mumadana ndi zabwino ndi kukonda zoyipa;
inu amene mumasenda khungu la anthu anga,
ndipo mumakungunula mnofu pa mafupa awo;
Nthawi imeneyo Iye adzawabisira nkhope yake
Dzuwa lidzawalowera aneneriwo, ndipo mdima udzawagwera.
Koma kunena za ine, ndadzazidwa ndi mphamvu,
kuti ndilalikire za kugalukira kwa Yakobo,
Imvani izi, inu atsogoleri a nyumba ya Yakobo,
inu amene mumadana ndi kuweruza kolungama;
inu amene mukumanga Ziyoni pokhetsa magazi,
Atsogoleri ake amalandira chiphuphu kuti aweruze,
ansembe ake amalandira malipiro kuti alalikire,
ndipo aneneri ake amanenera kuti alandire ndalama.
Komatu amatsamira pa Yehova nʼkumanena kuti,
ndipo phiri la Nyumba ya Mulungu lidzasanduka nkhalango yowirira.

items.text: phiri la Nyumba ya Yehova adzalikhazikitsa
kukhala lalitali kuposa mapiri ena onse.
Lidzaonekera pamwamba pa mapiri ena onse,
ndipo anthu amitundu yonse adzathamangira kumeneko.
ku nyumba ya Mulungu wa Yakobo.
mawu a Yehova adzachokera ku Yerusalemu.
Iye adzaweruza pakati pa anthu amitundu yambiri
ndipo adzathetsa kusamvana pakati pa anthu amphamvu akutali ndi apafupi omwe.
Anthuwo adzasandutsa malupanga awo kukhala makasu
Mtundu wina sudzatenganso lupanga kumenyana ndi mtundu wina,
Munthu aliyense adzakhala pansi pa tsinde pa mtengo wake wa mpesa
ndi pa tsinde pa mtengo wake wamkuyu,
Anthu olumalawo ndidzawasandutsa anthu anga otsala.
Anthu amene ndinawachotsa ndidzawasandutsa mtundu wamphamvu.
Kunena za iwe, nsanja ya ziweto zanga,
iwe linga la mwana wamkazi wa Ziyoni,
ulamuliro wako wakale udzabwezeretsedwa kwa iwe;
ufumu udzabwera pa mwana wamkazi wa Yerusalemu."
kotero kuti ululu wako uli ngati wa mayi amene akubereka?
Gubuduka ndi ululu, iwe mwana wamkazi wa Ziyoni,
ngati mayi pa nthawi yake yobereka,
pakuti tsopano muyenera kuchoka mu mzinda
Koma tsopano mitundu yambiri ya anthu
maso athu aone chiwonongeko cha Ziyoni!"
Iye amene amawatuta ngati mitolo ya tirigu ku malo opunthira tirigu.
"Imirira, puntha, iwe mwana wamkazi wa Ziyoni,
ndipo udzaphwanya mitundu yambiri ya anthu."
Phindu lawo lolipeza molakwikalo udzalipereka kwa Yehova,
chuma chawo kwa Yehova wa dziko lonse lapansi.

items.text: Iwe mzinda wa anthu ankhondo, sonkhanitsa anthu ako ankhondo,
pakuti anthu atizungulira kuti alimbane nafe.
ngakhale uli wonyozeka pakati pa mafuko a Yuda,
mpaka pa nthawi imene mayi amene ali woyembekezera adzachire.
Ndipo abale ake onse otsalira adzabwerera
Iye adzalimbika, ndipo adzaweta nkhosa zake
mu ulemerero wa dzina la Yehova Mulungu wake.
pakuti ukulu wake udzakhala ponseponse pa dziko lapansi.
ndi kuyamba kuthira nkhondo malo athu otetezedwa,
Iwo adzagonjetsa dziko la Asiriya ndi lupanga,
pakati pa mitundu yambiri ya anthu
Otsala a Yakobo adzakhala pakati pa mitundu ya anthu,
mʼgulu la anthu a mitundu yambiri,
ngati mkango pakati pa nyama za mʼnkhalango.
Ngati mwana wa mkango pakati pa gulu la nkhosa,
pamodzi ndi miyala yanu yopatulika imene ili pakati panu;
Ndidzazula mitengo ya mafano a Asera imene ili pakati panu,

items.text: "Nyamukani, fotokozani mlandu wanu pamaso pa mapiri;
zitunda zimve zimene inu muti muyankhule.
Imvani mlandu wa Yehova, inu mapiri;
tamverani, maziko amuyaya a dziko lapansi.
Pakuti Yehova ali ndi mlandu ndi anthu ake;
Ine ndinakutulutsani ku dziko la Igupto
ndi kukuwombolani ku nyumba ya ukapolo.
zimene Balaki mfumu ya ku Mowabu inafuna kukuchitirani
ndiponso zimene Balaamu mwana wa Beori anayankha.
Kumbukirani zomwe zinachitika pa ulendo wochoka ku Sitimu kupita ku Giligala,
kuti mudziwe machitidwe olungama a Yehova."
Kodi ndidzatenga chiyani kupita nacho pamaso pa Yehova
ndi kukagwada pamaso pa Mulungu wakumwamba?
Kodi ndidzabwera pamaso pake ndi nsembe yopsereza,
ndi ana angʼombe a chaka chimodzi?
Kodi Yehova adzakondwera ndi nkhosa zazimuna 1,000,
kapena ndi mitsinje yosalekeza ya mafuta?
Kodi ndipereke nsembe mwana wanga woyamba kubadwa chifukwa cha zolakwa zanga?
Chipatso cha thupi langa chifukwa cha tchimo la moyo wanga?
Munthu iwe, Yehova wakuonetsa kale chimene chili chabwino.
Tsono kodi Yehova akuyembekezera chiyani kwa iwe?
ndiponso kuyenda modzichepetsa pamaso pa Mulungu wako.
Kulakwa kwa Israeli ndi Chilango chake
Tamverani! Yehova akuyitana anthu okhala mu mzinda
Inu anthu oyipa, kodi Ine nʼkuyiwala
ndiponso muyeso wanu woperewera umene ndi wotembereredwa?
Kodi ndimutenge ngati wosalakwa munthu amene ali ndi sikelo yachinyengo,
chifukwa zimene mudzasunga zidzawonongedwa ndi lupanga.
Mudzayenga mafuta a olivi, koma simudzawagwiritsa ntchito.
Mudzaponda mphesa, koma simudzamwa vinyo wake.
ndiponso machitidwe onse a banja la Ahabu,
ndiponso anthu anu kuti azunguzike mitu;
mudzanyozedwa ndi anthu a mitundu ina."

items.text: Ndili ngati munthu wokunkha zipatso nthawi yachilimwe,
palibe nkhuyu zoyambirira zimene ndimazilakalaka kwambiri.
palibe wolungama ndi mmodzi yemwe amene watsala.
aliyense akusaka mʼbale wake ndi khoka.
Manja awo onse ndi aluso pochita zoyipa;
anthu amphamvu amalamula kuti zichitike zimene akuzifuna,
Munthu wabwino kwambiri pakati pawo ali ngati mtengo waminga,
munthu wolungama kwambiri pakati pawo ndi woyipa kuposa mpanda waminga.
Tsiku limene alonda ako ananena lafika,
Tsopano ndi nthawi ya chisokonezo chawo.
Pakuti mwana wamwamuna akunyoza abambo ake,
adani a munthu ndi amene amakhala nawo mʼbanja mwake momwe.
Ndidzaona kugonjetsedwa kwake ndi maso anga;
Nthawi imeneyo anthu adzabwera kwa inu
kuchokera ku Asiriya ndi mizinda ya ku Igupto,
ngakhale kuchokera ku Igupto mpaka ku Yufurate
ndiponso kuchokera ku nyanja ina mpaka ku nyanja inanso
kuchokera ku phiri lina mpaka ku phiri linanso.
chifukwa cha anthu okhala mʼdzikomo, potsatira zochita za anthuwo.
Wetani anthu anu ndi ndodo yanu yowateteza,
Muzilole kuti zidye mu Basani ndi mu Giliyadi
ngati masiku amene ndinawatulutsa mʼdziko la Igupto."
Mitundu ya anthu idzaona zimenezi ndipo idzachita manyazi,
mwamantha adzatembenukira kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu
amene amakhululukira tchimo ndi kuyiwala zolakwa
za anthu otsala amene ndi cholowa chake?
ndi kuponyera zolakwa zathu zonse pansi pa nyanja.
ndi kuonetsa chifundo chanu kwa Abrahamu,
monga munalonjeza molumbira kwa makolo athu
